rationale.conceptual: The core method (DFT, Varvenne-Clouet mapping, linear elasticity) is well-established and the task provides explicit recipes. The agent only needs to implement a standard protocol on a known code. While the mapping from residual stress to dipole tensor and the construction of the compliance tensor require some care, the overall difficulty is that of a standard method with a minor adaptation.
rationale.execution: The workflow involves setting up and running three sequential DFT calculations (perfect, vacancy, transition state) on a 3×3×3 supercell, then performing post-processing linear algebra. This amounts to a multi-stage pipeline (at least 4-5 logical steps) with dependencies between the DFT runs. Handling the correct supercell construction, pseudopotential, k-point sampling, extracting residual stress, and parsing output requires non-trivial orchestration, even if each component is standard.
